title: Flatulency
summary: FLAT'ULENCY, n. [See Flatulent.] 1. Windiness in the stomach; air generated in a weak stomach and intestines by imperfect digestion, occasioning distension, uneasiness, pain, and often belchings.2. Ai

inlines.v: FLAT'ULENCY, n. [See Flatulent.] 1. Windiness in the stomach; air generated in a weak stomach and intestines by imperfect digestion, occasioning distension, uneasiness, pain, and often belchings.2. Airiness; emptiness; vanity.
